stat: How much faster UK SME AI adoption grew in the year to 2026 than its average annual pace in the two years before
unit: x (multiple of average annual percentage-point growth)
method: Recipe C (year-on-year delta from snapshots) — BCC and Atos publish four separate annual adoption percentages (2023-2026) but do not publish the year-on-year growth rate or its acceleration

sources_used.title: Half of SMEs Using AI - With Limited Headcount Impact So Far
sources_used.publisher: British Chambers of Commerce and Atos, with the University of Essex ESRC Centre for Micro-Social Change (MiSoC)

workings: The BCC/Atos Future of Work: AI in the Workplace survey series reports UK SME AI adoption at 23% (2023), 25% (2024), 35% (2025) and 54% (2026). Year-on-year deltas: 2023-24: +2pp, 2024-25: +10pp, 2025-26: +19pp. Average annual pace across the two years 2023-2025: (35-23)/2 = 6pp/year. Single-year pace 2025-2026: +19pp. Ratio of the most recent year's pace to the prior average: 19/6 = 3.1667, rounded to 3.2x. The source publishes each year's adoption percentage separately but does not state the year-on-year growth rate or its acceleration.
